edges.description: End-organ failure to transduce PTH and TSH signals manifests clinically and biochemically as hormone resistance.
Renal PTH resistance can produce low circulating calcium, although calcium can remain normal in some affected individuals.
TSH resistance can reduce thyroid-hormone output, ranging from compensated biochemical resistance to hypothyroidism.
PDE4D-related neurodevelopmental dysfunction manifests as variable intellectual disability.
Motor, speech, and broader developmental delays occur in PDE4D-related disease.
